notes.subject: הלוא … ?
notes.rationale: Hebrew negative-rhetorical question expects 'yes'; Tok Pisin renders it as a question with 'no' inside, keeping the rhetorical push

notes.subject: אתקוטט
notes.rationale: root קוט 'cut off/detest' in hitpael: 'quarrel with' (KJV 'grieved') vs literal 'detest/cut myself from'; rendered 'kotim tok' (quarrel)

translation: Mi no les long ol man i les long yu, Yahwe? Na long ol birua bilong yu, mi kotim tok long ol?

tokens.gloss: ol man i les long yu
na long ol birua bilong yu
